Ordinary nights confirmed: the county posts a 'Non-Fair Camping' daily price ($40), not an event-only arrangement. Weekly and monthly rates are also posted; the site count and how many sites go by the month are not stated (occupancy not measurable: phone booking).

Pin: stored 43.66019,-93.35907 is at the fairgrounds' southeast entrance on Bridge Avenue. Imagery shows rows of parked campers in the southwest part of the grounds around 43.6615,-93.3628 (~330 m W), but they may be event or storage units; the hookup sites could not be told apart, so no move is recommended.
